description: In DBeaver, connect to the Chinook SQLite database and write a SQL query to find all tracks by the artist 'AC/DC'. Your query should return the track names from the AC/DC discography. Execute the query in DBeaver's SQL Editor - you should see exactly 18 tracks in the results. Save the query results to a file at /home/ga/Documents/exports/acdc_tracks.csv using DBeaver's export feature or by copying the results.
